text: And no, and I can hear talk in the background. I say, "Yo, it's yo, what's up?" Ready for the person to start talking. And I realize I don't even know how this happened. If he said my name and it just dialed me, but he was in a conversation with someone else about me, not talking to me. They didn't even realize that they had called me, and it was so painful. This guy who told me he has my bag no matter what. I was hearing him talk poorly about me to someone else, and I was so.
